title: Synthesis of some new pyrimidine-based pyrene/benzochromene hybrids as EGFR kinase inhibitors in HCT-116 cancer cells through apoptosis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,30683-30696
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA03611A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yassin Adam A. Mohammed, Nabila A. Kheder, Mohamed S. Nafie, Ashraf A. Abbas, Kamal M. Dawood
A series of pyrimidine-based pyrene/benzochromene hybrids was constructed and screened for their anticancer potential against HepG2, HCT-116, and WI-38 cell lines. Compounds 4b and 4c were the most potent inhibitors against HCT-116 cancer cells.
